firmware.window.what: Open one build's own window: what it is, where it lives, and how it is run.

params.name: version
params.what: the build's version or imported label

params.name: role
params.what: which role, when one label carries more than one

params.name: board
params.what: which board; absent means a build for this machine

firmware.window.answers: The build it opened on, once. Refused where there is no user interface, and refused for a build the library does not hold or a label naming more than one, so nobody is left closing an empty window.

example.what: open a build to change what it is run as
